subject: Kickoff: Dedicated Capacity MAP — roles, throughput targets, and close timeline
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.in>
To: Tom Harper <tom.harper@nebula.ai>, Sophie Lim <sophie@nebula.ai>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.in, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.in, markus_klein@redwood.in
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Dedicated Capacity MAP — roles, throughput targets, and close timeline

Hi Tom / Sophie —

Thanks again for taking time with us last week. As discussed, wed like to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align stakeholders, confirm throughput targets for the Dedicated GPU pool, and land on a firm close/evaluation timeline. The attached draft MAP and capacity spreadsheet are the starting point.

High-level proposed MAP (timeline view):
- Week 0 (this week): Stakeholder roll call + finalize throughput & scale targets
- Week 1: Evaluation plan (test prompts, latency/99pct targets, token budgets)
- Week 2: PoC/validation on a small reserved pool + smoke tests
- Week 3: Final capacity sign-off, procurement paperwork, scheduling Dedicated window

Key asks from Nebula:
1) Confirm primary technical owner (name & email) we should route infra questions to
2) Confirm throughput targets (concurrent RPS, average seq length, peak-day token/sec)
3) Identify any data residency / on-prem constraints we should account for

Internal roles (initial):
- Jasmine Liu — Account lead / MAP owner (me)
- Dev Patel — Capacity engineer / sizing worksheet owner
- Stephanie Nguyen — Solutions & evaluation plan
- Markus Klein — Dedicated pool onboarding & SLA lead

Please reply with stakeholder names and any immediate constraints. If it works for you, Ill book a 60-minute kickoff this week (link below) to walk the MAP and assign owners.

Attachments:
- Nebula_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft, includes milestones & responsibilities)
- dedicated_capacity_estimate.xlsx (capacity worksheet — Dev will fill after your input)

Calendly: https://cal.com/jasmine/kickoff-60
Drive: https://redwood.in/drive/NB-2026-0423/MAP-draft

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.in | +1 (415) 555-0189

From: Tom Harper <tom.harper@nebula.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.in>
Cc: Sophie Lim <sophie@nebula.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated Capacity MAP — roles, throughput targets, and close timeline

Jasmine —

Thanks, looks good. Quick answers to start:
- Primary technical owner: Sophie Lim (sophie@nebula.ai) — she'll own validation + infra sign-off
- High-level throughput targets: 300 concurrent requests at 1.5 qps/request average, median sequence length ~256 tokens, peak token/sec target ~120k tokens/sec (we can validate).
- Data residency: US only, no additional on-prem constraints for this phase.

We want a 2-week validation window and to be live on Dedicated by the end of the month if the MAP stays on track. We'll loop in our procurement team (contracts@nebula.ai) once the capacity numbers are finalized.

Can you ask Dev to fill the capacity worksheet with the recommended GPU pool configuration and expected token costs? Also include a fallback plan if we see 30% higher peak than expected.

Cc: dev_patel@redwood.in, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.in, markus_klein@redwood.in
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated Capacity MAP — roles, throughput targets, and close timeline

Tom, Sophie —

Appreciate the quick answers, that's helpful. Attached: updated MAP draft (v1) and the capacity estimate sheet populated with the high-level assumptions you gave. Dev, could you please: 
- Fill the "Recommended GPU Config" tab with concrete pool sizing (instance types, GPUs per node, node count for baseline and +30% headroom)
- Provide an expected 95/99 latency estimate for the sample workloads (given median seq 256)
- Add a short fallback playbook (auto-scale / burst options and cost delta)

Stephanie, please draft the evaluation plan (short runbook + prompt set and acceptance criteria) by Monday so Nebula can review.

Next steps for Nebula: confirm Sophie as tech owner (Tom noted), and confirm whether procurement needs a PO or full contract redline to proceed. Sophie / contracts@nebula.ai, can you confirm?

Attachments:
- Nebula_MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 420KB)
- dedicated_capacity_estimate.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 110KB)

Thanks,
Jasmine

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.in>

Cc: markus_klein@redwood.in, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.in
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated Capacity MAP — roles, throughput targets, and close timeline

Jasmine —

I updated the dedicated_capacity_estimate.xlsx with recommended configs and a +30% headroom scenario. Summary:
- Baseline: 8x A800 nodes (8x80GB GPUs), expected sustained throughput ~110k token/sec, 95p latency ~180ms on median seq=256
- Headroom (+30%): add 2 nodes (total 10) — peak token/sec ~143k
- Fallback: short-burst autoscale to pre-warmed spot nodes for 20 minutes (estimated cost +12% during bursts)

Attached: dedicated_capacity_estimate.xlsx (updated).

Let me know if you want a second sizing option (NVIDIA H100-based) for comparison.

- Dev

From: Sophie Lim <sophie@nebula.ai>

Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Dedicated Capacity MAP — roles, throughput targets, and close timeline

Jasmine / team —

Thanks for pulling this together. Sophie here (tech owner). Numbers look reasonable and the fallback approach is acceptable to our SREs. A couple of items before we lock dates:
- Procurement: contracts@nebula.ai prefers an SOW + PO rather than an immediate contract redline. We can prepare a PO after we receive final capacity numbers and an estimated monthly cost.
- Evaluation: we'll run a 10-day validation window starting Dec 13 (internal calendar permitting). Please confirm the Dedicated window availability and a target go-live of Dec 28 if validation passes.
- KPIs: target 99p latency < 400ms, success rate > 99.5% on the test prompt set. Stephanie, ping me with the evaluation plan and the prompt set.

I'll join the kickoff; Tom will look after procurement. See you on the call.

Best,
Sophie Lim
Head of Platform Engineering | Nebula Analytics
sophie@nebula.ai
